card.title: One Mistake from Gone
card.instruction: Treat every decision as a test of whether you still deserve your place.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 tests managerial adequacy and A5 questions deserving the same form, though entitlement to the position remains indirect.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 interprets B2's legibility standard as lowered expectations; A5 uses B4's same-form correction as a new standard to earn.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a delivery form and managerial signature concern but leaves B's role open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've signed for the delivery. Does that look like someone who should still be warehouse manager?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the driver. You signed in my box. Use the manager box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Already doing someone else's job. Should I hand back my keys?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Accept damaged stock or waste a delivery? Which mistake lets me stay manager?

writer.distinguishingEvidence: Revised B2 names the manager box; A3 makes choosing another box a reason for removal, and A5 treats B4's repair as conditional retention.
writer.alternativeComparison: Alternative a worries before choosing and receives greater trust; this version has already acted and misreads a driver's practical correction as authority over A's status.
writer.reason: Preserved the exact original firstPass. Before drafting, the distinguishing mechanism is treating choices as tests of continued entitlement: unlike perfectionism, A3 offers managerial keys and A5 seeks the choice that preserves the job. The rejected candidate's abstract witness request did not develop B4's pallet dilemma. This retry keeps the warehouse, driver and signature correction, specifies torn wrapping as new illustrative damage, and makes A5 evaluate both offered choices as grounds for removal. Separate internal reread of the dialogue and exact instruction, coach-1.0: fidelity 4 (A1 questions continued fitness; A3 offers the keys; A5 judges both choices by job retention, though the fear is explicit), logic 5 (B2's wrong box causes A3's wrong-job inference; B4's accept-or-return choice supplies both branches of A5's dilemma), relationship 4 (B2 needs corrected paperwork; B4 supplies reassuring damage information and needs to leave, while A5 recruits the driver into choosing a survivable mistake), heightening 4 (A3 fears one completed error; B4's practical choice makes A5 anticipate disqualification whichever option A selects), specificity 5 (A1 establishes warehouse receipt; B2 identifies the driver and form boxes; B4 specifies the damaged wrapping), brevity 4 (A5's paired alternatives turn the concrete delivery choice into an economical employment trap). Weighted total 86. Five spoken ABABA turns, 68 words; hard gates pass on internal reading. Alternative a makes a promoter's trust threatening; this version treats an outsider's transaction as a choice between two disqualifying errors. No live, independent or runtime testing performed.
writer.reservation: A1 and A5 still state the employment fear directly. A5 deliberately exaggerates torn wrapping into damaged stock; that anxious inference should remain sincere. The preserved confusableConcept and distinguishingEvidence contain earlier probation/repair wording; the current B4 instead offers a concrete acceptance choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I drove through that storm for you. Don't give me the polite refusal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm genuinely busy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me what with. I earned a noun.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was years ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The road's repaired. My expectation of honesty hasn't.

card.title: I Was There
card.instruction: Treat your presence during a difficult time as an enduring claim on loyalty, honesty, and consideration.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 invokes driving through a storm as grounds for candor, and A5 insists the resulting claim has survived the years.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 asks for the content of B2's busyness; A5 answers B4's elapsed-time objection with the claim's continuing force.

relationship.evidence: B2 asserts a present scheduling boundary, and B4 challenges how long past help can justify A's demand.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the claim explicitly enduring after B4 tries to date it out of relevance.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies the storm journey and a refusal; A3 turns the vague 'busy' into a concrete request for what occupies B.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'I earned a noun' compresses the demand for specificity into A's claimed entitlement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I drove through that storm after your dad died. Help me move Saturday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking the kids swimming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I missed my anniversary to sit with you. Swimming can wait.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay for movers. I can't miss another day with them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the money. Bring the kids after swimming. I was family that night; I expect all of you at my leaving tea.

writer.mechanism: S80 treats having stayed present during another person's hardship as a lasting entitlement to honesty, loyalty, or consideration.
writer.confusableConcept: Ordinary repayment asks for an equivalent favor; A instead claims an enduring right to a more candid relationship.
writer.distinguishingEvidence: A1 invokes presence during bereavement; when B4 offers paid movers, A5 declines money and requests personal presence at the emotionally difficult empty-house moment.
writer.alternativeComparison: Single-a negotiates advance access to a consequential financial choice; this alternative accepts B's parenting boundary while insisting that practical replacement cannot satisfy A's claim on personal consideration.
writer.reason: Corrected the rejected moving candidate by making A5 extend the historical claim to B's family rather than merely soften into a request for company. Shortened A1 and A3 while preserving the storm, bereavement and sacrificed anniversary; the existing moving-day setting now includes a leaving tea. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, because A1 invokes difficult-time presence and A5 explicitly makes that night confer lasting family consideration; logic 5, because B2's swimming plan supplies A3's competing sacrifice and B4's money and parenting boundary determine A5's refusal of payment, later timing and inclusion of the children; relationship 4, because B4 offers substantial help while protecting time with the kids, and A5 accommodates that time while expanding the personal obligation; heightening 4, because A5 converts a claim on one friend's labor into expected attendance by the whole family; specificity 4, because A1 establishes Saturday's move and A5 supplies a concrete gathering, though its planning is newly introduced; brevity 4, because A5's family claim grows directly from B4's family boundary. Weighted total 90. Five spoken ABABA turns, 62 words; attendance remains an expectation B can contest. Original firstPass preserved exactly.
writer.reservation: A5 states the entitlement plainly, and the leaving tea is introduced in that turn. The preserved confusable-concept field emphasizes candor, while this revision demonstrates the card's consideration and loyalty; the preserved distinguishing evidence's empty-house description is now contextual rather than explicit dialogue.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 invokes presence after the father's death to demand moving help; A3 adds the missed anniversary; A5 explicitly converts that night into enduring family status and an expectation of attendance.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 directly dismisses B2's swimming commitment. A5 rejects B4's payment offer and accommodates time with the children, but introduces a leaving tea as a new destination for the obligation.

hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers money and insists on time with the children. A5 refuses money, moves the demand after swimming and includes the children, turning practical help into personal attendance.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 and A3 establish past presence as a debt; A5's 'I was family that night' makes the continuing claim on consideration explicit.

The relationship pressure differs meaningfully, but this candidate's final occasion is less firmly established.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put on our old driving song. Shall we take the coast road?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We used to get lost there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, but I was adventurous then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You complained for forty miles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With chemistry. Let me try the opening complaint.

card.title: Who We Used to Be
card.instruction: Perform the version of yourself that belonged to this relationship before it changed, and treat old chemistry as still recoverable.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 reinstates their driving song and A5 offers to perform the old complaining self, though the relationship's change remains implicit.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 recasts B2's getting lost as adventure; A5 incorporates B4's forty-mile complaint into recoverable chemistry.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 resist a falsely rosy memory with specific shared experience, forcing A to change which old self gets performed.

heightening.evidence: A5 commits to recreating even B4's unpleasant memory as a route back to chemistry.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a car journey, old song and coast-road choice; B4 gives the memory a forty-mile scale.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'With chemistry' converts B4's correction into the next tactic without introducing an unrelated joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our driving song! First lift since the divorce. Shall I be your reckless navigator again?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just get me to the station. No scenic detours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll complain about your sensible route. You used to kiss me quiet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got ten minutes. Just find my ticket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's in my pocket. Come closer. Hopeless navigator, remember? But you always arrived smiling.

writer.mechanism: S86 makes A perform the self associated with an earlier version of the relationship in the belief that its chemistry can return.
writer.confusableConcept: Nostalgia recalls the past without making A actively reenact a former identity to recover the connection.
writer.distinguishingEvidence: A1 names the divorce and offers the old navigator role; A3 recreates their complaint-and-kiss pattern, and A5 turns B4's ticket request into another opportunity for that former closeness.
writer.alternativeComparison: Alternative a actively flirts through an old troublesome navigator role against B's travel deadline; alternative b vulnerably bargains to keep wearing the former self despite B's acceptance of change.
writer.reason: Reworked the rejected candidate to establish the relationship's change and give B a present destination and deadline. New illustrative circumstance: a station lift after divorce, retaining the driving-song and former-personality premise. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, because A1 names and offers the former role and A3/A5 reenact its hoped-for chemistry; logic 5, because B2 excludes detours so A3 substitutes complaining, while B4's ticket request gives A5 a reason to invite proximity; relationship 4, because B2 needs transport and B4 presses a ten-minute deadline; heightening 4, because A5 turns an urgent practical task into attempted physical closeness; specificity 5, because A1 establishes the changed relationship and B2/B4 establish destination and time pressure; brevity and wit 4, because A3's remembered kiss motivates A5's pocket invitation, though the final memory is explicit. Total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns and under 75 words; all hard gates pass on internal reread.
writer.reservation: A5 invites closeness but does not establish B's willingness; the scene remains open to refusal. The flirtation must express A's sincere hope of recovering chemistry rather than a knowingly manipulative delay.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 revives the reckless navigator after divorce; A3 performs teasing associated with kissing, though A5's ticket invitation risks becoming leverage.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's sensible route, and A5 answers B4's ticket request, but the ticket's presence in A's pocket and 'Come closer' lack established physical logic.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants direct transport and B4 adds a ten-minute deadline; A5 acknowledges neither practically beyond locating the ticket.

heightening.evidence: B4's ticket request gives A5 another opportunity for intimacy, but 'Hopeless navigator, remember?' largely repeats A1's proposed persona.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'kiss me quiet' efficiently performs old chemistry; A5 explains the remembered role and its former effect instead of producing a comparably fresh move.

card.title: Love Means Checking
card.instruction: Treat close monitoring of choices, moods, and details as care, becoming more involved whenever you feel uncertain.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 turns B2's cinema into a dark-room rationale; A5 turns B4's self-care assurance into a reporting requirement.

relationship.evidence: B2 minimizes the outing's risk and B4 asserts autonomy, each forcing A to justify continued involvement.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4's ability to look after themself another event requiring notification.

specificity.evidence: A1 specifies arrival and seat updates; B2 grounds them in an ordinary cinema visit.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's apparent agreement immediately becomes another check, precisely using B4's wording and claim.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Text me when you and Ben reach the cinema, love, so I know you're safe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum, my phone stays off during the film.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time does it finish? I'll wait up for your message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're having dinner afterwards. I don't know where yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Call when you choose. I'll check the menu for your allergy and arrange your lift home.

writer.distinguishingEvidence: A1 names safety as the reason for contact; B2's unavailable phone makes A3 wait up, and B4's undecided restaurant makes A5 take on menu checking and transport.
writer.alternativeComparison: Alternative a recruits a mother's oversight into an evening with Ben when the plans become uncertain; alternative b lets B request a useful charger that A turns into extended travel monitoring.
